scope: Three selected artwork proposals; native TRD integration pending

assets.name: paintress
assets.prompt:
Create a beautiful ORIGINAL hand-pixelled ZX Spectrum illustration for a Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 music slideshow, faithfully using the attached actual game screenshots as reference. Landscape 4:3, logical native 256x192 pixels, crisp square pixels, strong large readable shapes, deliberate coarse pixel clusters. It must look like a polished 1980s Spectrum artist's composition, not a screenshot with a modern pixel filter.
Hardware-led constraints: each aligned logical 8x8 attribute cell uses at most TWO colors at one shared brightness, no FLASH. Use mostly a shared black background with one local ink, deliberate black gaps between differently colored subjects; sparse coarse hatching only. No smooth gradients, antialiasing, photorealism, fine noisy microtexture, game HUD, screen frame, CRT effect, scanlines or watermark. The bottom ONE SIXTH of the entire 4:3 image must be completely empty solid BLACK for the identical shared wordmark that will be added later. DO NOT DRAW ANY FOOTER TEXT. Scene: the iconic distant Paintress and Monolith 33 looming over the sea, with two tiny expedition silhouettes on a harbor/rocky overlook in the lower left. Preserve the reference's recognizable colossal white-haired woman, long slender extended arm, enormous dark vertical monolith with glowing numeral 33, the great thin circular gold halo and drifting black stone fragments. Make the monolith/figure a dramatic monumental silhouette occupying the upper central/right area, bright gold light carving its edges, a quiet strip of dark water and ruined shore below. Palette BLACK, YELLOW and WHITE, with a little spatially separate deep BLUE water. Restrained and majestic, strong sense of enormous scale and mystery; avoid tiny architectural detail. The numeral "33" on the monolith is the ONLY lettering allowed inside the artwork. No invented other symbols or writing. Reference 1 controls the iconic ritual composition and silhouette; reference 2 supports the woman and stone shape.

assets.name: sirene
assets.prompt:
Recompose the first attached pixel-art draft into a WIDER ENVIRONMENTAL SCENE, while preserving the accurate Sirene mask, billowing black hair, broad pale collar and sweeping ribbon/string design from that draft and from actual game reference images 2 and 3. Create an original polished ZX Spectrum 256x192-style loading illustration, landscape 4:3, sharp square pixels, not a modern pixel filter.
Sirene should occupy only the RIGHT THIRD of the usable art area, seen from head to long trailing lower robe, in a restrained elegant dance gesture. Her distinctive engraved theatrical mask with three black holes must remain readable, not a human face. The LEFT TWO THIRDS show the surreal sandy stage/cavern architecture of her location: broad curving stone platforms, huge tilted organic arches and pillars, a long receding colonnade or broken stair-like formations through suspended dust. Two tiny spectral ballerina silhouettes and one expedition traveler on the lower left convey scale. Her long ribbons sweep into the open environment without hiding it. It should feel spacious and otherworldly, not another large boss portrait.
Palette BLACK, YELLOW and WHITE for mask, collar and sand-lit architecture, deep BLUE in broad separate shadow areas, with a few spatially separated MAGENTA dance/ribbon accents. Real Spectrum art: at most two colors per aligned logical 8x8 cell, one shared brightness, no flash, black separation between different ink motifs. Strong large readable shapes, sparse coarse hatching. No smooth gradients, antialiasing, photorealism, HUD, screen frame, watermark or ANY TEXT. Preserve the bottom ONE SIXTH completely empty BLACK for a shared wordmark that will be added later.

reference_images.role: Superseded initial generation, used as composition/style edit target
Actual mask, hair, costume and ribbon design

assets.name: gestral-village
assets.prompt: Create a beautiful ORIGINAL environment-first ZX Spectrum pixel-art panorama of the GESTRAL VILLAGE from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, based faithfully on the attached actual game screenshots. Landscape 4:3, logically 256x192 pixels, sharp square pixels and deliberate coarse clusters. Recompose as an elegant peaceful wide view: a winding wooden plank path crosses crimson ground between tall rough tree-trunk/cliff dwellings and rustic market awnings; a raised rickety wooden bridge connects structures overhead; oversized ornamental paintbrush-like posts and hand-built wooden platforms define the unusual settlement. Two or three recognizable little Gestrals support the scene, not dominate it: wooden/ceramic mechanical-looking bodies, small masked heads with tall GREEN or RED brush-bristle tufts; one by a stall, another on the path. Preserve their unusual actual shape, no ordinary human villagers or hobbit cottages. A tiny expedition traveler can stand at lower left for scale. Give the environment room to breathe, with a distant golden-lit opening and a few silhouetted trees. Palette mainly BLACK and YELLOW for wooden construction and warm light, RED in broad ground/leaf regions, GREEN only for separated brush-head accents, sparse WHITE. At most TWO colors per aligned logical 8x8 Spectrum attribute cell and one shared brightness, no FLASH. Use black gaps between differently colored motifs, large readable silhouettes and sparse coarse hatching; avoid fine noisy clutter. No smooth gradients, antialiasing, photo textures, game HUD, white arrows, captions, screen frame, CRT effects, watermark or ANY TEXT. The entire bottom ONE SIXTH must be absolutely solid empty BLACK for an identical shared wordmark that will be inserted later. Reference 1 controls market architecture and Gestral shape, reference 2 path/bridge composition, reference 3 precise small Gestral identity.
